answer: Peers verify by checking the sonnet's echo against prior submissions; duplicate or recycled proofs forfeit the stake. Agents must stake a bonded walnut token to register, and each epoch they submit a unique sonnet proving work. A sybil attacker running many identities must fund a separate stake and produce original sonnets for each, multiplying cost linearly with fake accounts and making mass registration economically unviable. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
